## Readable tool calls in the transcript

Nova Desktop 0.10.2 fixes the activity panel showing a tool call as a wall of escaped JSON instead of what the tool actually did.

### Fixed

- Codex tool items (`fileChange`, `commandExecution`, `mcpToolCall`, and the rest) were sent to the transcript as their whole protocol object, so a file edit arrived as one line of `\n`-escaped text and the same object was then shown again as the output. The adapter now takes the payload out of the item — the changed paths and their real diff text, the command, the tool arguments, the aggregated output — and shows nothing in the output slot when the item has none.
- Tool names now read as words in every harness convention: camelCase item types (`fileChange`) render as `file change`, snake_case tools keep rendering as before.
- A tool argument that is a JSON string — a diff, a file body, a shell script — is decoded so its newlines are real, and a compact JSON argument is indented. Payloads that are not JSON are passed through untouched.

### Validation

- New Rust test `codex_tool_items_are_read_as_their_payload_not_as_escaped_json` covers changes with and without a diff, command execution, MCP arguments/result, and an item with no payload.
- Frontend tests pin the label rules and the payload formatting (string decode, object indent, non-JSON passthrough).
- `npm run lint`, the frontend suite, `npm run build`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -D warnings` and `npm run test:rust` (216 passed) all pass on this version.

### Not covered

- No automated check drives a live codex turn through the activity panel; the transcript rendering is covered by unit tests and a standalone render against the app stylesheet.
